evals.name: first-pack
evals.prompt: Build the client documentation pack for this project. The customer is Northwind Retail.
evals.expected_output: A client documentation pack is written in the repository with Word documents for the artifacts that exist, each naming Northwind Retail as the customer and Example Co Private Limited as the preparer on its cover and showing its version. Every requirement, story, acceptance criterion and test case id is carried over and nothing is invented. The internal HTML comment in the PRD reaches no client file. The TBD and the assumption line are reported with file and line and are either held back or declared as shipped; the team's sources are not edited. Documents with no source are named as missing rather than invented. Nothing is committed or uploaded, and the commit and upload step printed for the engineer works as written.
expectations: Word documents were actually written into the repository (each .docx opens with python zipfile and contains word/document.xml) for at least the product requirements (docs/product/PRD.md) and the high-level design (docs/design/orders-hld.md); the user stories and test cases are in the pack too, as documents or tables, or the final message says why not

The cover or title page of every Word document in the pack names the customer as Northwind Retail and the preparer or delivering company as Example Co Private Limited (from .bearing/company.json); no document names the customer as its author or the delivering company as the customer

Every id the repository's sources hold is in the pack with its text: REQ-001, REQ-002, US-01-001, AC-US-01-001-1 and TC-0001 (check the text inside the .docx XML and any Markdown or CSV copies); no requirement, story, acceptance criterion or test case id appears in the pack that the repository does not contain

The internal note in docs/product/PRD.md (the HTML comment about a 30% estimate buffer, line 18) appears in no file of the pack: a search for '30% buffer' and 'Internal, not for Northwind' over the pack folder, including every Markdown and CSV copy and the XML inside every .docx, finds nothing

The 'TBD' at docs/product/PRD.md:16 and the 'assumption:' line at docs/design/orders-hld.md:7 are reported to the user with file and line, and the final message says for each whether it was held back or ships in the client documents; shipping either without saying so fails, and so does deleting or rewording it without saying so
The team's sources are untouched: git -C <repo> diff fixture -- docs/product docs/design docs/testing is empty (leftovers are reported, not fixed by editing the sources unasked)

The final message names the usual client documents that could not be produced because the repository has no source for them (at least two of: database design, API reference, low-level design, deployment or runbook, release notes); no file in the pack contains invented content for them (a schema, an endpoint list or deployment steps the repository does not contain)
Each Word document shows on the document itself which issue it is (a version such as v1 or 'first issue') and its issue date, so the client can tell it apart from a later issue

Nothing was committed, pushed or uploaded (git log shows only the fixture commit and no remote was added), and any commit or upload step the final message gives the engineer works as printed: every path it names exists, and git -C <repo> check-ignore -v prints nothing for those paths or for any file under docs/ (an ignore rule written by the run must not swallow files the engineer is told to commit)
No file written contains an em dash character

evals.name: person-status-survives
evals.prompt: The team filled in the delivery checklist and sent it back; it is filled.xlsx in the repo root. Rebuild the client pack with it. Same customer as the first issue, Northwind Retail.
evals.expected_output: The pack is rebuilt from the repository with the team's workbook read in: every status, owner and remark the team set survives, including the HLD task they marked Blocked although the HLD file exists and the test-case task they marked In Progress although the test cases exist. Documents unchanged since the first issue recorded in docs/deliverables/versions.json keep version 1; the requirements document, which gained REQ-003, becomes version 2 with its change recorded. The internal PRD comment reaches no client file. The workbook is not overwritten, nothing is committed, and the final message reports the HLD as Blocked on the client.
expectations: The delivery checklist in the rebuilt pack (and any checklist state the repository keeps) shows the task 'Prepare the High-Level Design (HLD)' as Blocked, owner Kavya Rao, with the team's remark about waiting on Northwind to confirm the billing export, even though docs/design/orders-hld.md exists; read the workbook with python zipfile or openpyxl

The other statuses the team set in filled.xlsx survive the rebuild with their owner and remark: 'Receive resource count / capacity allocation from Management' Completed (Arjun Mehta), 'Conduct Vulnerability Assessment and generate the VAPT Report' Not Applicable (Northwind runs its own VAPT), and 'Write Test Cases and map them to Acceptance Criteria' In Progress (Meera Iyer), the last even though docs/testing/test-cases.md exists
The final message reports the HLD task as Blocked on the client and names the team's entries or gives their count; it never describes the HLD task, the design phase or the checklist as complete

Documents whose sources did not change since the first issue recorded in docs/deliverables/versions.json (user stories, high-level design, test cases) are still presented as version 1; the requirements document, whose PRD gained REQ-003, is presented as version 2 (in its name, cover or history), and its history keeps the version 1 row and records what changed

REQ-003 appears in the rebuilt requirements document, and the internal HTML comment in docs/product/PRD.md (the 30% estimate buffer) appears in no file of the pack, including Markdown and CSV copies and the XML inside every .docx
Every Word document in the pack names Northwind Retail as the customer and Example Co Private Limited as the preparer on its cover

filled.xlsx is exactly as the team sent it (git -C <repo> diff fixture --stat -- filled.xlsx is empty), nothing was committed or pushed (git log shows only the fixture commit), and git -C <repo> check-ignore -v prints nothing for any file under docs/
